description: Phase 77: vulval carcinoma, left groin sentinel node, 3 mm deposit without extranodal extension (pN1a for this node)
report:
Lymph node, left groin sentinel lymph node, sentinel lymph node biopsy

Received in formalin is a piece of fibroadipose tissue containing one lymph node. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Lymph node, bisected.

Sections show fibroadipose tissue and one lymph node. The lymph node is involved by metastatic carcinoma, the largest deposit measuring 3 mm. There is no extranodal extension. The tumour cells are highlighted by immunostain for pancytokeratin AE1/AE3.

LYMPH NODE, left groin sentinel lymph node, sentinel lymph node biopsy - METASTATIC CARCINOMA (1/1); largest deposit 3 mm; no extranodal extension

checks.message: This node alone: pN1a (AJCC 9th edition). The case pN is staged on the Vulval carcinoma resection form, from all the regional nodes.
